children: Northern Trust Chief Financial Officer Dave Fox will retire at the end of the first quarter of 2027.
The company on Tuesday said it plans to initiate an internal and external search for a successor. Fox will continue to lead the company's finances through the search.
Write to Elias Schisgall at elias.schisgall@wsj.com
